source_title: Maoists on tax collection drive in Jhapa
spatial_scope: Damak, Bhadrapur, and Mechinagar municipalities, Jhapa; no districtwide claim
coding_rationale: The report dated 4 Sep states that Maoists began collecting municipal taxes, issued their own tender notice, and had allocated contracts in Damak, with tax collection also reported in Bhadrapur and Mechinagar.
